pvp.title: PvP
query: SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.pvpkills > 0 ORDER BY pvpkills DESC, time_in_game DESC LIMIT 10;

pk.title: PK
query: SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.pkkills > 0 ORDER BY pvpkills DESC, time_in_game DESC LIMIT 10;

online.title: Online
query: SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.onlinetime > 0 ORDER BY time_in_game DESC LIMIT 10;

exp.title: EXP
query: SELECT characters.charId AS player_id, characters.char_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.sex, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.base_class AS class_id, characters.`level`, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM characters LEFT JOIN clan_data ON characters.clanid = clan_data.clan_id WHERE characters.exp > 0 ORDER BY time_in_game DESC LIMIT 10;

clan.title: Clans
query: SELECT clan_data.hasCastle AS castle_id, clan_data.reputation_score AS reputation_score, clan_data.leader_id, clan_data.clan_name AS player_name, characters.pvpkills AS pvp, characters.pkkills AS pk, characters.`online`, characters.onlinetime AS time_in_game, characters.sex,  clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE clanid = clan_data.clan_id) AS clan_count_members FROM clan_data INNER JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.charId ORDER BY clan_data.reputation_score DESC, clan_count_members DESC LIMIT 10;;

castle.title: Castle
query: SELECT castle.id AS castle_id, castle.taxPercent AS tax, castle.treasury AS treasury, castle.siegeDate AS dataSiege, clan_data.clan_name, clan_data.clan_level, characters.char_name, NULL AS clan_crest, NULL AS alliance_crest FROM castle LEFT JOIN clan_data ON castle.id = clan_data.hasCastle LEFT JOIN characters ON clan_data.leader_id = characters.charId;
